wrong: pushed a skipped (Not proven) test as PASSED in Xray with a 'checked by hand' comment
right: a skipped test stays TO DO or goes to the user as a manual test
rule: before any Xray status push, compare with work/<KEY>/run-results.json: a skipped / fixme / Not proven test is never PASSED, whatever the reason

wrong: Specs used filter/search/delete steps that were never checked live: Select All toggled while a search text hid options, search box typed without Enter, deleteWork returned silently when the row was not drawn and waited for a deleted row to disappear, Deck tag removed without opening the editor
right: Filter: clear search, untick Select All to none, then tick exact labels; table search needs Enter; deleted works stay in the grid with Status text D; cleanup must find the row (scroll) and fail loudly
caught: user answered script bug for TC-008/009/019/020 after a live Chrome check (2026-11-24)
rule: Before writing a UI step that filters, searches or deletes, check how the page really behaves (UI facts doc or a live check by the lead) and never let a helper return silently when its target is not found

wrong: ETM-8736 pasted a fixed Start date (05 Jun 2026) that fails the plan schedule check, so the app reverted the whole paste
right: pasted dates must come from the target rows' own schedule (e.g. current Start + 1 day), inside the plan window
rule: Never hard-code a date for a Shutdown Logic paste; derive it from the row's current dates

wrong: ETM-8737 expected the seeded Duration 12 to show as 12; the app fits Duration to the working calendar (10.00)
right: after seeding, read the value the row shows and use it as the expected value
rule: Never expect a pasted Shutdown Logic Duration/date to show the typed number; read the row's value after the seed

wrong: ETM-8653 step 9 unticked the only ticked Remark option, then looked for W06 in a table that is empty when nothing is ticked
right: When nothing is ticked the table is empty (like other columns); tick Select All before looking for another row
caught: user tested by hand on QA
rule: After unticking the last ticked option in a column filter, tick Select All (or Reset) before any step that needs other rows

wrong: ETM-8658 step 7 typed in the table search box while the Remark filter panel was still open; the filters were lost
right: Close the filter panel (Apply) before typing in the table search box
caught: user judged the failure a script bug
rule: Close any open column filter panel before typing in the table search box

wrong: ETM-8743 compared the Gantt bar length with the pasted Duration in calendar hours (24 h); the bar spans non-working time (37 h)
right: compare the bar with the row's own Start/End from the store
rule: Never compare a Shutdown Logic bar length with Duration hours; compare bar start/end with the row's Start/End

wrong: ETM-8748 clicked an already-selected Gantt cell before Ctrl+V; deselectOnClick un-selected it, so the paste had no target
right: after clicking, check the cell is selected (gantt.selectedCells) and click again if not
rule: Shutdown Logic grid has deselectOnClick: confirm the paste anchor cell is selected before Ctrl+V

wrong: ETM-8658 step 4 passed by reading stale rows before the new search response arrived (hid defect ETM-9229)
right: After a search or filter action, wait for the search request/response before reading rows
caught: trace review after a later step failed
rule: After any action that reloads table data, wait for its network response (or a changed row count/URL) before asserting rows

wrong: Counted dependency lines with .b-sch-dependency, which also matches Bryntum's transparent click-area path (b-click-area): one line counted as 2
caught: ETM-8634 step 1 failed with 2; trace showed a -click-area path per dependency
rule: When counting Bryntum dependency lines, exclude .b-click-area

wrong: levelBox() fell back to 'the first Expand/Collapse all button' when the Platform label regex did not match; the locked Platform button is labelled 'Platform (always expanded)', so the script clicked Work Header and a false defect ETM-9175 was logged
right: Find each level button by its own aria-label only (Platform: 'Platform (always expanded)', disabled); no fallback by position
caught: Dev-brief source read: stms-fe Platform button isLocked/disabled; manual check on QA (work/ETM-8449/manual-9175) not reproduced; user deleted ETM-9175
rule: Never fall back to a positional locator (nth) for a control the test asserts on; if the label does not match, fail. Before logging a defect from a script failure, reproduce it by hand once

wrong: Read the user's F-6 answer as 'lower levels keep their own box' (not said), wrote 8633 s5 / 8635 s5 to expect all rows back, and logged ETM-9177 although ETM-8449 is performance only and the cascade code was unchanged from before the Story (ETM-2431)
right: The existing cascade (ETM-2431) is correct: '-' at a level hides that level and every level below; '+' shows that level and the levels above only. A perf-only Story keeps the old behaviour
caught: Dev brief source read showed the cascade unchanged since before ETM-8449; user ruled 25 Nov 2026: system correct, BA F-2 wrong
rule: For a 'no behaviour change' Story, compare the expected result with the behaviour before the Story (old code / old AC) before writing it into a TC or a defect; do not add rules the user did not say; when a user answer and an existing AC disagree, ask which wins before logging a defect

wrong: Concluded the S-Curve filter button is disabled for the Job Owner from a failed run on an INACTIVE plan (the card flashed with a disabled button before Access Denied), wrote it as BA Q1, a script note and an Xray comment on ETM-8807
right: The filter is enabled for the Job Owner on Active plans (user screenshot, recheck on eND50 and QA EMP Del A). Q1 withdrawn
how: Before reporting a role difference, recheck on the right data (an Active plan for JO) after the page settles, and compare both roles on the same page
